note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 5176 Section 3.4 and HEAD code (coa.go admitRequest). TestRFC5176MessageAuthenticatorAbsentIsAcceptedByDefault sends a valid Disconnect-Request omitting Message-Authenticator under the default config (CoARequireMessageAuthenticator false) and asserts Disconnect-ACK and one teardown. TestCoAListenerMissingMessageAuthenticatorDroppedWhenRequired enables CoARequireMessageAuthenticator and asserts an otherwise valid unsigned-MA CoA-Request gets no response. Mandatory verification when present is separately tested by 3.4-3.
